The '''Mobquet Flare-V swoop bike''' was a type of [[Swoop/Legends|swoop]] that was produced by [[Mobquet Swoops and Speeders/Legends|Mobquet Swoops and Speeders]]. The bike was extremely fast and infamously tough to fly, which made it rather dangerous. It was often used by [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] and other criminals. [[Lor Keln]], the founder of the [[Crimson Kreehawks]], used a Mobquet Flare-V swoop bike.<ref name="CotG" />
